sandbox.notes: A human runs `pytest -q` from the repo root with the project's venv activated. pytest reaches the cell through PATH, which the cell keeps whole, so the venv the run was launched from is the venv the check uses; nothing is installed inside a cell. PYTHONPATH is passed because it decides which tree wins: a venv holding an editable install of this project points at the pursuit, not at the cell, and a relative PYTHONPATH (`.` here, `src` in a src-layout repo) resolves inside whichever tree is cwd, so the branch's own code is what gets imported. VIRTUAL_ENV is passed because pytest plugins, tox and uv read it to decide which interpreter they are in. `python3 -m pytest` is the same command and must not be declared as a tool: doctor reads the token after an interpreter as the script and reports `-m is not there`.
